note: LEADS.md Part U lead U8 (hcharbonnier/radiance-rdna3 W41c): a build option plus a run-time switch. build-kvpf = the build-win cmake line plus -DSTRATA_ATTN_KV_PREFETCH=ON (compiles attn_chunk_pf_kernel in src/kernels/cuda/qsa_decode_attn.cu: the K row of the next cell and the V rows of the next STRATA_ATTN_KV_PREFETCH_DEPTH=4 cells are loaded into registers before the current cells' arithmetic); STRATA_ATTN_KV_PREFETCH=1 selects it for qsa_decode_attn_step and the plain batch path (not for lane-cell, split-grid, window, slots or WMMA variants). Expected at most 0.3% (QSA decode attention is 3.0% of decode GPU time, LEADS.md U8): run the kernel microbench first (ctest -R qsa_kv_prefetch_parity, then hip_decode_attn_wmma_parity --bench style timing or rocprof on the attention kernel at 2K / 32K) and this engine screen only if the kernel gains >= 10%.
